name: DonnyAvatar
description: The assistant's animated avatar with thinking, speaking, and idle mood states, used inside ChatWidget and Donny surfaces.

state.description: Current expression or assistant lifecycle state.

onTransitionEnd.description: Called when the state transition animation ends.

showLabel.description: Shows the current state label for diagnostics.

trackMouse.description: Makes the eyes follow the pointer.

proximitySelectors.description: CSS selectors whose pointer proximity can trigger curious or playful behavior.

onProximityChange.description: Called when proximity to a tracked target changes.

idleExpressionInterval.description: Base idle-expression interval in milliseconds (default 8000), randomized by 50 percent.

isSpeaking.description: Animates the mouth during streaming responses.

enableSleepDetection.description: Enables sleepy and sleeping states after pointer inactivity.

sleepyDelay.description: Inactivity delay before the sleepy state, in milliseconds (default 120000).

sleepDelay.description: Inactivity delay before the sleeping state, in milliseconds (default 150000).

decorative.description: Removes role and label when a parent control owns the accessible name (e.g. the chat toggle).
